rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Walk-away test (M2+).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: One exercise = one bounded activity.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The bounded activity is packaging one prior run: diagnose it, derive the needed checks, build the dominant verifier, and assemble the two remaining package files.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Modules composable across variants.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The shared exercise uses scoped variant flags only in the closing handoff and does not fork the exercise body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Three-level completeness.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The M5 contrast frame leads to runtime diagnosis and smoke-tested artifacts, which in turn supply the module-level packaged re-send.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Pattern-recognition LOs need n≥2 instances with contrast.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Phase 1 applies three lenses to quoted moments; Phase 2 contrasts three validation categories; Phase 3 contrasts three verifier shapes against one dominant failure.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Progression-with-variations is the spine.
rules_evaluated.evidence: M5 repeats M4's send-off as a changed-variable experiment: the same task returns packaged, so the move recurs with a materially different face.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Student agency — adults decide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The engineer chooses the dominant failure and verifier shape. Expanded line 93 permits summary depth after the useful moments land, and line 171 makes the engineer the Phase 4 stop gate.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Delegation — student brings, Claude screens.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Claude reads the accessible task.md, worktree state, and recorded transcript; it pattern-matches and drafts, while the engineer chooses impact, shape, and readiness.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Split mega-exercise when phases = distinct skills + distinct artifacts.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Re-derived against the current rule boundary: the four phases chain mechanically in one warm session with no natural pause. Phase 1's dominant failure drives Phase 2's validation, the chosen validation drives Phase 3's verifier, and that verifier's constraints feed Phase 4's reference and plan.md. The package is the single artifact-set the next re-send consumes. Splitting at Phase 3 or 4 would add setup and a context boundary without separating the learning.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Artifact-realism check.
rules_evaluated.evidence: task.md, the M4 branch, transcript path, worktree, repository conventions, and Claude Code session are concrete artifacts established by the module flow.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Teach principle + technique — default.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Each failure lens, validation category, and verifier shape is paired with why it fits and how it fires.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Auto-fire sim+eval after significant rewrite.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The final body has a fresh three-persona story trace and current story and pedagogy class re-fires keyed to the same raw-source SHA.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Forcing functions stay, scripted reactions go. Forcing functions live in prompts, not body prose.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The fences carry the quoted diagnosis, backward validation map, verifier build, PASS/FAIL smoke test, and locked package assembly. Expanded lines 93 and 171 are human attention/stop governors, not scripted reactions: they let the engineer cut depth while the prompt machinery stays full-strength.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Corporate infra = nice-to-have, never forcing function.
rules_evaluated.evidence: All learning lands inside the student's repo and Claude Code session; CI or hook conventions shape one optional verifier implementation rather than gate the exercise.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Personal-first, team promotion via human conversation.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The exercise authors task-local packaging, not a shared-infrastructure promotion.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Measure silent failure, not just friction.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Cohort measurement rule, not a static exercise-body requirement.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't pre-set categories before experiment runs.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The three lenses are applied only after the un-packaged M4 experiment has produced its evidence.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Verification layers sample DIFFERENT error distributions — not belt-and-braces.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Quote-location checks test diagnosis grounding, synthetic PASS/FAIL tests check verifier wiring, and the subsequent re-send tests the package against real task behavior.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cheap-before-expensive verification ordering.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The exercise orders cheap quote checks before verifier construction, then smoke-tests the verifier before assembling and re-sending the full package.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Rule in memory without forcing function = worse than no rule.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No memory rule is authored or compounded in this exercise.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Short skeptical pushback on "done" = re-verify trigger.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The smoke-test prompt reopens the verifier against one passing and one failing case rather than accepting a confident completion report.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cohort execution is trainer-paced + concurrent, not sequential.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The file states one exercise runtime and phase budget; it does not add trainer demonstration and room execution as separate sequential charges.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Host-skill optional; maintainer blocks trainer-only.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No host skill is required, and the maintainer recovery material names trainer diagnostics rather than a universal installed helper.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Reflection beats: in-chat over file-write.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No reflection-only file is created; all writes are load-bearing inputs to the re-send.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Classroom = default delivery; body teaches work, trainer manages room.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The body contains no pair, group-share, room-discussion, or authored pause cue.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Eval = fixed yardstick; thing measured learns.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No iterative score trajectory or mutable scorer is designed in this exercise.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Reading burden for verification = banned. Claude audits Claude.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The apparent proxy match at expanded lines 175 and 180 does not produce the guarded harm: the engineer reads the two package artifacts to exercise the operator judgement the lesson teaches, while Claude performs transcript grounding and automated PASS/FAIL verification. Selective-depth and good-enough gates prevent this from becoming exhaustive manual error-checking; replacing the judgement beat with another self-audit would weaken the exercise.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Self-report + self-audit charity — verify at artifact, over-flag or fresh-session for critique.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Phase 1 makes Claude locate quoted moments in the transcript, and Phase 4 checks the actual files rather than ending on Claude's prose summary.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Offered structures need forced-engagement mechanic.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The student must select a dominant failure, choose a matching verifier shape, push back on mismatch, and smoke-test both PASS and FAIL behavior before proceeding.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Source-type blindness on ingestion.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The exercise reads a repository and JSONL transcript, not a heterogeneous source folder with slide-format extraction risk.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Task selection drives outcome → name floor AND ceiling.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Maintainer-block hedge naming section's own failure mode = cut-signal, not warning.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Audience tier determines authoring substrate.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Verification machinery needs smoke-test before trust.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Context-loading tiers as staged progression.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Removals are strategic — ask before cutting.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Eval architecture — partition by evidence source, not criterion count.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Plug points + UX.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Per-phase failure mode + escape hatch.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heavy fan-out prompts get body recovery callout.
